resources.string: Also when a DeKoi goes offline
Tap a kind of notification to change it in your phone’s settings.
Once a week, a short note: how many alerts and new devices your DeKoi saw, and how much of the time it was online.
The names, network addresses and hardware addresses of the devices on your network. Names can include people’s names.
Who made those devices, and their models.
User names typed into its decoys, never the passwords.
A code that lets it send notifications to this phone.
Alerts are kept for 90 days, and devices and networks for 90 days after DeKoi last sees them. Deleting your account removes all of it.
Removes your account, your DeKoi devices and everything they reported.
This removes your account, your DeKoi devices and all their history. It can’t be undone.

Wi-Fi Guard warns you when a Wi-Fi network near your DeKoi copies this name to trick your devices into joining. It needs only the name, never your Wi-Fi password.
Exactly as your phone shows it. Leave it empty to turn Wi-Fi Guard off.
Add the name of your Wi-Fi so Wi-Fi Guard can warn you if someone copies it.
